project_type: Hackathon MVP — FastAPI backend + React/Vite/TypeScript frontend + Arduino firmware
build_system: pip (backend, no workspace tooling), npm/vite (frontend). Backend deps installed into global Python 3.11 env or a venv. Frontend uses `npm install` then `npm run dev` / `npm run build`.
test_framework: pytest (backend — run `cd backend && pytest app/tests/ -v`); no frontend test framework required by spec
build_command: backend: `cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt`; frontend: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`
verification_instructions: 1. `cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt` — must succeed. 2. `cd backend && uvicorn main:app --port 8000` — server starts, GET /api/health returns {status:ok}. 3. `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` — Vite build succeeds with zero TS errors. 4. `cd backend && pytest app/tests/ -v` — all unit tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/solarflow.db is created at runtime by SQLite; it is gitignored. No checked-in generated files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Python 3.11.9 at C:\Users\ADMIN\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python311\python.exe. sklearn 1.8.0 and pandas 3.0.1 already installed globally. fastapi, uvicorn, and other backend deps must be installed via requirements.txt. Node 24.15 / npm 11.12. Never commit secrets or .env files — only .env.example.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md exists. Follow spec: TypeScript strict mode (no `any`), hardware command allowlist only ["fan_on","fan_off","noop"], never fabricate model accuracy (label synthetic/unvalidated clearly), charts must show threshold lines, all files must be complete.
key_patterns: Greenfield — no existing patterns to inherit. Follow FastAPI router pattern (APIRouter per domain), SQLite via SQLAlchemy sync, APScheduler for background tasks, Pydantic v2 schemas, Recharts in frontend. React functional components + hooks only. No class components.
directory_structure: SolarFlow/ — workspace root with README.md. backend/ — FastAPI app, SQLite DB, ML services. frontend/ — React/Vite/TypeScript SPA. firmware/ — Arduino sketch and protocol docs. .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (never committed).
